 Follow Salma Hayek Is A Vision In A Red Sparkly Gown At LACMA Gala With Her Billionaire Husband: 'Divine'
 Maria Pierides Thu, November 12, 2026 at 12:45 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Fresh from stepping out in a blonde wig to celebrate Halloween – dressed as her friend Penélope Cruz's character from The Invite , no less – Salma Hayek returned to her signature dark locks for the 15th annual LACMA Art+Film Gala on Saturday, November 7th. And she looked absolutely phenomenal in the process!
 The Oscar-nominated actress attended the star-studded event with her billionaire husband, François-Henri Pinault , joining the likes of Kim Kardashian, Nicole Kidman, Anya Taylor-Joy, and more at the Los Angeles County Museum of Art. The annual gala, presented by Gucci and co-chaired by Leonardo DiCaprio and Eva Chow , raises funds to support the museum' s film initiatives and wider programming.
 Salma Hayek and Francois-Henri Pinault LACMA gala
 Salma Hayek Wows In A Figure-Hugging Red Gucci Gown At The 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala
 The 60-year-old actress poured her sensational curves into a figure-hugging, bold red Gucci gown, which was covered in dazzling sequins from top to bottom. The floor-length dress featured an asymmetric neckline, one long sleeve, and flattering ruched detailing around the waist, making it the perfect choice for such a glamorous occasion. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The House of Gucci star accessorized the show-stopping number with a matching red clutch bag, also by the Italian fashion house. For jewelry, she opted for a dazzling bracelet and Boucheron Vendôme Liseré and Plume de Paon rings, which only added to the glamour.
 Her dark hair was worn in a center-parted down 'do, styled in voluminous curls, while her makeup consisted of smoky eyes, rosy cheeks, and a soft pink lip.
 Salma Hayek red Gucci gown LACMA gala
 Fan Comments
 Fans were completely blown away by the Frida alum's glamorous appearance , with many taking to social media to shower her with compliments!
 "Simply fabulous," commented one fan on Instagram , followed by a red heart emoji. "She's such a goddess," gushed a second. "Dear Salma, as always, you are divine," raved a third, while a fourth wrote: "She's perfect."
 Advertisement Advertisement "She looks so amazing," praised a fifth, followed by a sixth who called her an "eternal beauty." Others couldn't get enough of her gorgeous Gucci gown, with a seventh writing: "Love this dress!" "Love her dress, she's stunning," agreed an eighth, while a ninth simply called her an "icon." We couldn't agree more!
 Other fans were equally impressed by the way her husband looked at her on the red carpet, and couldn't help but praise their relationship. "The way her husband looks at her," noted a tenth, followed by the heart-eyes emoji.
 "She is stunning and he adores her! Love," added an eleventh, followed by a red heart emoji, while a twelfth wrote: "He is a very lucky guy." "Beautiful couple," concluded a thirteenth, followed by red heart, fire, and clapping hands emojis.
